head: MaskRCNN shared trainable256 projection, RPN, box and genuine-mask-only branches
optimizer: SGD momentum.9 weight_decay.0005; StepLR step3 gamma.1
seed_semantics: training_randomness: head initialization, shuffle, RPN/RoI sampling; fixed publisher fold membership
selection: Official fold1 seed0 candidates; final epoch10 validation bboxAP, tie lowerLR; fixed for fresh fits on folds2-5; no early stopping on evaluation folds
fold_aggregation: equal fold weight; folds and training seeds remain separate; never pool repetitions as independent FOVs
metrics: COCO class-aware AP, maxDets300, ambiguous class8 GT crowd and predictions excluded; Hungarian IoU>=.5 class-agnostic integer box matching for classification and genuine mask Dice; zero-overlap matched masks retained; fixed score threshold torchvision.05 and mask threshold.5
invalid_candidate_rule: Nonfinite training candidate excluded with recorded loss; choose from valid prescribed LRs on fold1 validation only; all-invalid blocks only the affected model
input: Annotated FOV crop in RGB/CSV coordinates; publisher class253 defines ROI; no resizing of mixed raster; published FM input normalization as shared native adapter; no augmentation
limitations: Project frozen-encoder head comparison, not a reproduction of the paper model
Independent polygon rasterization avoids released rectangle overlay corruption and 1-2px raster/RGB mismatch; all models share these masks
Matched-mask Dice conditions on detection matches; AP and matched-mask count reported alongside
Corrected publisher mask target indexing after excluding ambiguous objects and retained zero-overlap matched masks; changes explicitly shared by all models
Publisher fold1 model selection followed by folds2-5 evaluation; do not describe this as nested CV
